comment: Came Wednesday morning and the fresh cranberries were completely gone.
No sweet potatoes left at all by noon, had to drive to another store.
Empty bins where the russet potatoes should be. Very frustrating the day before Thanksgiving.
Fresh sage and thyme were sold out, only dried herbs on the shelf.
The green beans looked great and were nicely trimmed.
Celery and onions all gone by the afternoon, nothing to restock them with.
Waited forty minutes at the bakery counter to pick up a pre-ordered pie.
The bakery line wrapped around the aisle and only one person was serving.
Pumpkin pie was delicious, worth it.
Took over half an hour just to collect my dinner rolls order.
Pickup for pre-orders was painfully slow, nobody called the numbers.
Way too long a queue at the bakery for a pre-paid order.
Heavy cream went up a dollar since last week.
Butter is far more expensive than in October.
Plenty of milk and eggs on the shelves, easy trip.
Whipped cream cans cost almost double what they did last year.
Sour cream and cream cheese prices are getting ridiculous.
Why is the store-brand butter priced the same as the name brand now?
Our turkey was juicy and perfectly fresh, best one in years.
Staff at the meat counter helped me pick the right size bird.
The 20 lb turkeys were sold out, so we got two smaller ones instead. They were great.
Great quality ham, the whole family loved it.
Butcher trimmed and tied the roast for free, very friendly.
Fresh turkey breast was excellent and fairly priced.
